The test failure indicates that the method is not properly validating non-positive limits, resulting in an incorrect error message.

```python
if self.get_xscale() == 'log':
    if left <= 0:
        cbook._warn_external(
            'Attempted to set non-positive left xlim on a '
            'log-scaled axis.\\n'
            'Invalid limit will be ignored.')

    if right <= 0:
        cbook._warn_external(
            'Attempted to set non-positive right xlim on a '
            'log-scaled axis.\\n'
            'Invalid limit will be ignored.')
        right = old_right
```
